ace: Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
cardEffects:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may place 1 yellow Tamer card or 1 single-color Option card with a cost of 5 or less from your hand on top of your security stack.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an Option card is used, or when a card is added to a security stack, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP for the turn.
name: Sakuyamon: Maid Mode
nameJapanese: サクヤモン：巫女モード

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  Option cards that reduce the cost upon use don't change the card's original cost, therefore you can't use this card's effect to place such a card on top of your security stack.
rulings.question: When I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place a card on top of my security stack, can I place an Option card with an original cost of 6 or more that has its cost reduced upon use?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can.  If the cost of an Option card consistently changes when it's in the hand and becomes 5 or less due to that card's effect, you can use this card's effect to place it on top of your security stack.
rulings.question: When I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place an Option card on top of my security stack, can I place an Option card that had its cost reduced to 5 or less by a "reduce the cost of this card in the hand by 1" effect on a card such as BT2-099 [Glorious Burst] or BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]?
